issue.title: Agent sync help test assumes the Python 3.13 argparse option format on Python 3.12
issue.description: Found by sase-1ou.6.land--3 while auditing the post-repair scheduled Full CI runs 40976564464 (f94ad24a4a) and 41011050293 (20dc76bd09). Both contain the Files repair but this failure is independent. Exact excerpts: file:explicit:26a0e166c4b017177f87eabb. All-status exact/semantic searches and past-week task sweep found no duplicate; reviewed active epics and found no demonstrated causal owner. Verify both option aliases and the intended help semantics without depending on a particular supported Python argparse rendering. Preserve retry-key validation behavior. This test predates the active published-state repair epic; do not conflate it with that repair.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Both scheduled Python 3.12 legs fail the literal assertion "-k, --retry-key" in help_text; Python 3.12 repeats the metavar for the short option, unlike newer argparse. The test remains unchanged in relevant assertion on master.

issue.creation_reason: Two scheduled CI audits independently expose this failure outside the Files navigation epic; record it for repair without blocking that epic.
